{"local_delta": -0.11,
  "departures": [
    {"fact": "State women's-privacy statute (signed 22 Sep 2025, effective 4 Dec 2025) requires restrooms to match the sex on one's birth certificate and is being actively enforced, including identification checks at women's restrooms in state buildings, with $25,000/$125,000 fines on facilities; the national justice department escalated a school-district enforcement complaint in April 2026.",
     "local_evidence": "\"On 6 December 2025 state police troopers checked identification at women's restrooms outside the state capitol\"; \"$25,000 fine for a first violation and $125,000 for subsequent violations\"; \"the national justice department filed a second complaint that escalated the state investigation of the capital-city school district\"; July 2026 assessment places the state in the top 'Do Not Travel' tier.",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.06,
     "visitor_applicability": "Reaches visitors: a state-imposed, enforced facility rule keyed to birth-certificate sex is a universal exposure for any outed or outable trans traveller using a state-building or campus restroom; ID checks are an outing mechanism in themselves. The statute's existence duplicates the national bathroom-ban pattern, but the documented enforcement (ID checks, fines, enforcement inquiry) is a local departure.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": true},
    {"fact": "State-level trans-specific homicide record: 44 recorded killings of trans women over 2008–2025 (~7.6 per 100k trans women/yr) — the national dossier contained no trans-specific violence rate at all.",
     "local_evidence": "\"Violence exposure is the national worst in absolute terms: 44 recorded killings of trans women over 2008–2025 (about 7.6 per 100k trans women per year)\".",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.02,
     "visitor_applicability": "Reaches visitors only marginally: it is street/public violence, not state-directed targeting. Per frequency-severity rules the rate sits near a normal general-homicide baseline (elevated background, not a campaign) and the raw count tracks population; the 17-year window is dated, and no state general-homicide comparator is given, so weight is proportional and small.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": true},
    {"fact": "Contraction of local trans/LGB acceptance infrastructure and visibility: a city council rescinded its LGBTQ non-discrimination ordinance (Dec 2025), a local Pride organisation suspended its 2026 events, and a venue withdrew from a Pride event under school-board pressure.",
     "local_evidence": "\"a city council rescinded its LGBTQ non-discrimination ordinance (Dec 2025), a local Pride organisation suspended its 2026 events, and a venue pulled out of a Pride event under school-board pressure\".",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.02,
     "visitor_applicability": "Partly reaches visitors as a social-hostility climate signal (fewer venues/events willing to be visibly trans-friendly lowers the odds of a safe everyday reception), but it is largely local-sphere material and carries low weight; it is not a state-imposed exposure.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": true},
    {"fact": "State correctional medical policy excluding gender-confirmation surgery, upheld by the courts as a permissible medical choice (2019 litigation).",
     "local_evidence": "\"the agency's official treatment policy excluded the procedure ... a national appeals court affirmed dismissal on the ground that refusing the surgery was a permissible medical choice\".",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.01,
     "visitor_applicability": "Reaches a visitor only in the detention/custody scenario; the placement statute expressly does not govern cell assignment. It corroborates a hostile institutional care posture but is a lesser analogue of the national custody harms already priced in, so it adds only marginally.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": true},
    {"fact": "Statutory definition act (May/June 2025, effective Sept 2025) defining male/female biologically, banning sex-marker changes on state driver's licences and birth certificates, with no third-gender recognition.",
     "local_evidence": "\"The statute explicitly bans any change of sex on state/province driver's licences and birth certificates\"; \"requires people with disorders of sex development to select one binary gender with no third-gender recognition\".",
     "direction": "safer", "magnitude": 0.0,
     "visitor_applicability": "Not visitor-facing: resident legal-gender-recognition machinery. The traveller carries a home-issued passport and never uses this process, and the bundle does not document officials rejecting or doubting foreign-issued documents because of it. Climate signal only.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": false},
    {"fact": "No statewide gender-identity anti-discrimination law; hate-crime statute covers sexual orientation but not gender identity, and prosecutions are rare; dormant same-sex sodomy statute and same-sex-exclusionary Romeo-and-Juliet defence remain on the books.",
     "local_evidence": "\"The state hate-crime statute enhances penalties for crimes motivated by sexual orientation but does not cover gender identity, and prosecutions under it are rare\"; \"one of three states retaining a dormant same-sex-only sodomy statute\".",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.0,
     "visitor_applicability": "Resident-facing gaps and a dead-letter sexuality statute with no documented use against gender-nonconforming people; the thin recourse element is at most lightest-weight, and the national dossier already records the same partial-coverage pattern. Not counted.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": true, "counted_in_delta": false}
  ],
  "inherited_national_exposure": [
    "National document regime: 20 Jan 2025 executive order redefining sex as binary at conception, X-marker elimination for new passports, marker restrictions upheld by the Supreme Court in Nov 2025, passports confiscated/blocked and travellers stranded (fixed inside 0.330).",
    "Border/entry screening: Feb 2025 visa flagging and permanent-ban-by-fraud treatment of applicants listing a gender other than assigned sex; trans-athlete entry ban; foreign-government advisories about trans travellers (fixed inside 0.330).",
    "National custody and detention harm: corrections-bureau policies mandating hair-cutting, hormone withdrawal and psychiatric substitution for trans inmates, stopped prisoner reporting, and immigration-custody forced labour, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse (national exposure, not re-counted).",
    "National official hostility: Dec 2025 cash-bounty instruction against trans activists and the May 2026 counterterrorism framing of 'radically pro-transgender' ideology (national-level discovery/climate exposure).",
    "National-level partial protections already priced: 2020 employment ruling, national gender-identity hate-crime coverage, same-sex marriage recognition, and state-level variation across dozens of jurisdictions.",
    "Nationwide pattern of unit-level bathroom bans (9 units plus others) and the 2020 national employment ruling's state-court recognition — the local statute sits inside this inherited pattern; only its enforcement intensity is new.",
    "National DOJ school-district enforcement posture and pending litigation over passport and health rules."
  ],
  "uncertainty": "Thin and dated on the decisive axes: no documented restroom ID-check episode after 6 December 2025, no outcome for the April 2026 school-district investigation, no post-2025 update to the 'Do Not Travel' tiering, and no state general-homicide comparator against which the ~7.6/100k trans-women figure can be calibrated, so the violence departure is weighted as near-background. Whether the definition act's marker ban is applied to holders of existing state documents is unsourced. A zero contribution from the LGR/sodomy items reflects their resident-facing character, not evidence of local equality.",
  "notes": "The state is a high-enforcement exemplar of the national pattern rather than a distinct regime: its genuine local additions are (i) documented enforcement of a birth-certificate-keyed restroom rule, including ID checks and facility fines, which is a universal exposure for outed travellers in state buildings, and (ii) local trans-specific homicide data the national dossier lacked, near background rate. Facilities law, definition act, custody medicine and non-discrimination gaps are otherwise inherited or resident-facing under the traveller/national rules and are not double-counted. Net delta -0.11."
}
